observed_reality: Frank central state code uses Python sqlite3 and WAL without an exact loaded-runtime identity gate before canonical database opens.
The self-hosted Ubuntu lane runner clay on host digital-retina executes /usr/bin/python3 with SQLite 3.45.1 on the measured baseline path.
The baseline loaded libsqlite3 artifact is /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libsqlite3.so.0.8.6 with SHA-256 f2cd05de8b6f71ea9d0495a6f9ff9cae844b15d9c45b7ef49ee0af0f81658cc7.

A disposable rootless build of official SQLite 3.53.4 was loaded by the same /usr/bin/python3 using a temporary LD_LIBRARY_PATH overlay; it reported the expected 3.53.4 source ID and no Frank database was opened.
grf.hypothesis: A package/CLI upgrade can diverge from the SQLite library actually loaded by the productive Python persistence path; release safety therefore requires runtime/source/artifact attestation rather than package-version evidence.
grf.counterhypothesis: The productive Python persistence path already loads a fixed SQLite runtime even if older system evidence exists.
grf.discriminating_test: Query sqlite_version() and sqlite_source_id() inside /usr/bin/python3 and fingerprint the mapped SQLite artifacts on the self-hosted Ubuntu lane without opening Frank databases.
grf.collapse: The counterhypothesis is rejected for the measured baseline path. A fixed 3.53.4 runtime is technically loadable by the same Python executable, but production integration/pinning remains unproved.

upstream_evidence.sqlite_wal_reset_affected: 3.7.0 through 3.51.2 under documented concurrent writer/checkpoint conditions

negative_results.result: A good CLI/package version cannot establish the library identity loaded by Python.
The measured baseline /usr/bin/python3 path on the self-hosted lane loads SQLite 3.45.1, not the newer 3.53.4 candidate.

unusual_experiment.description: A temporary fake sqlite3 CLI reported 3.53.4 while Python in the same environment reported its actually loaded SQLite 3.46.1; the temporary decoy was deleted immediately after measurement.
unusual_experiment.purpose: Falsify package/CLI-version evidence as a sufficient release signal.

candidate_implementation.architecture_delta: Probe -> trusted runtime pin -> fail-closed canonical DB open. Reject downgrade/library swap by exact runtime/source/artifact identity; do not accept CLI/package version alone.

remediation_feasibility.candidate: Official SQLite 3.53.4 rootless disposable runtime overlay on self-hosted Ubuntu lane

release_adjudication.reason: The baseline Python runtime remains SQLite 3.45.1. The official 3.53.4 overlay proves a viable local remediation mechanism but is disposable and not bound into Frank boot/persistence.
release_adjudication.next_smallest_falsifier: Install or provision the fixed runtime in the accepted production path, then make repo_truth_gate and migration/open paths fail closed on the exact admitted runtime/source/artifact identity; test downgrade and library-swap rejection before any canonical WAL DB open.
promotion_forbidden_until: fixed productive runtime is installed or otherwise bound
exact runtime/source/artifact identity is fail-closed before canonical WAL database opens
